coverage.english_only_boundary: English-oriented source audit; no multilingual coverage claim.
coverage.locale_language_limitation: ASCII/non-ASCII is not locale identification or language-quality evidence.

near_duplicate_candidates.generation: six deterministic MinHash/LSH views, token Jaccard plus character 3-gram similarity
near_duplicate_candidates.large_bucket_policy: every document is processed; deterministic per-document neighbor caps are reported rather than skipping large buckets
